(Iron grows stronger the more it is struck.
Now is the time to demonstrate my true strength—)

...It was disappointing. But there was no helping it.
Respecting Ikuno Dictus's wishes—

Through all the mock races thus far, I have finally caught sight of it:
the path to victory with the highest probability for someone as inexperienced as myself.
—HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!
...How was that?
My answer had already been decided—

I will substantiate that claim in the Debut Race three months from now.
Therefore, I ask that you first... watch that race, and then make your judgment.

"A strong, unyielding 'will' like iron. You possess the fortitude to see things through once you decide on them.
That is the greatest asset one can have in management."
(——I am by no means a strong Umamusume.)

......Yes, likewise.
I look forward to working with you, Trainer—
"An aptitude, you say? What sort of aptitude could that—"

That was a splendidly executed race. If you'd like, wouldn't you
aim for the top under my guidance?

—I felt it would not be fair. I have yet to demonstrate
my proper racing capability to you.

(To compete on the same stage where they run...
I have no choice but to push my strengths to their absolute limits and pierce through on that single point.)

"Whenever you find the goal you truly wish to achieve, rely on that 'will' of yours to
pursue it step by steady step. I am certain you will be able to accomplish any goal."

Precisely because you stated you wanted to support my goals...
I wish to show you that I am an Umamusume who can win, and live up to that.

A season passed after the last conversation
I had with Ikuno Dictus—

—As I am now, I am not worthy.
...Please grant me three months of time.

I walked up to Ikuno Dictus.
And with a will just as strong as hers, I put it into words.
—She crosses the finish line!! Taking first place is number 2, Ikuno Dictus!!

Ikuno Dictus bursts out here!
She surges to the front!! What tremendous speed!!

(Here at Tracen Academy, there are countless
wonderful Umamusume endowed with overwhelming talent.)

A fierce battle for position is unfolding!
This is bound to be a chaotic fray!!

...My hands naturally clench. I feel my heart beating faster.
And then, our exchange from "back then" comes rushing back—

"—As expected, Ikuno-kun,
you have a wonderful aptitude for management."
However————I must decline.

And so, the handshake I shared with Ikuno Dictus
became a pledge more solid than anything else—
On that day, I was walking along the cherry blossom-lined path on my way to a certain place—
Passing the 600m mark! Still a dense pack! Who will break away!?

(—In order to win today's Debut Race,
I ran numerous mock races and grasped the strongest form of running I can currently achieve.)

—That was incredible speed, Ikuno Dictus!
With running like that, won't you aim to become a GⅠ Umamusume together with me?!

—And they're off to a clean start!
The short-distance turf sprint over 1000m is underway!!
